notes: AuId (Autonummering) is deliberately left unmapped: the demo payload sends it `false`, meaning the itemcode is supplied rather than generated, which is exactly what the sheet's own Itemcode column already does by being present — AFAS defaults a missing boolean field to false, so leaving it out has the same effect as sending it explicitly.

`Grp` and `BiUn` are AFAS's only two mandatory fields on this connector (confirmed live) and both come straight from the sheet, so nothing had to be faked with a fixed value the way other modules' mandatory-but-columnless fields are.

Artikelgroep, Basiseenheid and BTW-Tariefgroep are all AFAS lookup fields (`controlType` 5/1, i.e. codes from another table), but only the latter two have their valid codes shipped inside the sjabloon itself — a 'Hulptabellen' tab listing Basiseenheid (BLK, DOZ, FLS, GEEN, KG, KM, KRT, L, M, STK, UUR) and BTW-Tariefgroep (0, 1, 2, Geen, U) — so the rule set checks those two with a plain `enum`, same pattern as erp-debiteuren's `BTW Plicht`. Artikelgroep has no such list in the sjabloon (artikelgroepen are inrichting-specific, like erp-projecten's Projectgroep) and is only checked as required text; see docs/todo.md for wiring a `codetabel` check once a connector for it exists in the customer's environment.
Not grouped: one artikel is one FbItemArticle record, the ordinary one-row-one-record path.

The other 113 fields on this connector (multi-language descriptions, prijzen, voorraadparameters, CBS/douane, verpakking, barcodes, …) have no column in this sjabloon and are left unmapped — none of them are mandatory.
